age.evidence: Male Wistar rats, 12 weeks old (300-350 g)

sex.evidence: Male Wistar rats... Each group initially had 11 animals (total n = 66)

dosing.evidence: Male Wistar rats received water, 120, 240, 480 or 3600 mg/kg of resuspended freeze-dried ayahuasca by gavage once a day for 30 days

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed in groups of 2 or 4 per cage

assays.assay_description: Round white wood arena (96 cm diameter, 34 cm walls) divided into 19 quadrants. Rats placed individually in centre, recorded for 20 min on day 30, 60 min after final gavage. Measures included total ambulation, inner-quadrant ambulation/entries/time, ratio, vertical exploration, grooming, freezing, behavioural transition probabilities (stochastic analysis), and 5-HT syndrome behaviours.

setup_restrain.evidence: placed individually into the open field centre

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum in home cage; open field arena does not contain food

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum in home cage; open field arena does not contain water

time_to_assay.evidence: on the 30th day, 60 min after gavage, they were placed individually into the open field

sample_size.evidence: Animals (n = 8-11/group) ... totalising a final sample of 8-11 animals per group

outcomes.summary: Repeated ayahuasca produced dose-dependent mixed effects: 120 mg/kg increased ambulation (stimulant-like), while 3600 mg/kg decreased vertical exploration and freezing frequency and reduced weight gain (likely adverse/toxic effects). No anxiolytic effect on inner-quadrant measures was observed after controlling for ambulation. Stochastic analysis revealed altered specific behavioural transitions but preserved overall sequential structure.
outcomes.statistics: Ambulation: W[4]=15.076, p=0.005; aya120 vs water post-hoc p=0.055, ß=0.551. Rearing time: W[4]=13.662, p=0.008; aya3600 vs water p=0.015, ß=-0.729. Freezing: W[4]=13.668, p=0.008; aya3600 vs water p=0.017, ß=-0.865. Weight gain: W[4]=16.241, p=0.003.
outcomes.evidence: Ayahuasca at 120 mg/kg increased ambulation, and at 3600 mg/kg decreased vertical exploration and reduced weight gain.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: we evaluated the ambulation repeatedly in three blocks of five minutes (0-5, 5-10, 10-15 min)

B8_multivariate.evidence: A multivariate approach based on the probability of behaviours transition was used using probability matrices

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single Open Field Test assay; consolidated as one assay.

B1 set to 7+ (score 3): candidates listed >=7 distinct measures (ambulation, inner-quadrant ambulation, inner entries, inner time, ratio, vertical exploration time, grooming, freezing, multiple specific transition frequencies).
B8 set to Yes: stochastic/probability-matrix analysis across multiple behaviours qualifies as multivariate behavioural analysis (matches glm and gptoss; overrode qwen).
Dosing schedule set to 'chronic' (30 consecutive daily doses, >7 days and >=8 doses).
Food/water restriction set to 'during' (ad libitum in home cage; not accessible in OF apparatus during 20 min test).
